payload.summary: Planned the adaptive model router: coordinator-owned catalog/resolver/ledger fed by OpenRouter (catalog refresher + real dispatch) and local endpoints, with benchmark priors blended against fleet feedback posteriors. Interview-mode discovery (7 questions) fixed latent intent on automation + durable learning with configurable trade-offs; Gate 1 selected Approach A (coordinator-native selection service).

decisions.title: Absorb cross-vendor-arbitrage-instrument and usage-stats-multi-model
decisions.rationale: OpenRouter live pricing supersedes the static price table; both drafts independently chose coordinator Postgres, so one capability (model-routing) owns the schema

decisions.title: Coordinator-native selection service over skills-layer or gateway router
decisions.rationale: Fleet-wide calibration needs shared durable state; external gateways cannot see CLI-subscription traffic

decisions.title: Static tier resolution stays as flag-gated fallback (ROUTING_ADAPTIVE)
decisions.rationale: Rollback plan for the breaking resolver delegation; additive-only migrations

decisions.title: Standing OpenRouter API key for refresher; MCP server dev-time only
decisions.rationale: MCP OAuth keys expire in 7 days with $10 cap - wrong shape for scheduled jobs

decisions.title: Dual-ceiling exploration budget (pct + monthly USD) and monthly metered spend ceiling
decisions.rationale: User chose explicit budget knob; monthly ceiling per discovery answer 7

next_steps: wp-contracts first; wp-db-catalog is the flagged-L critical path
